original_benchmark.notes: 612 public vimgolf.com challenges (james4ever0/vimgolf-gym, HF James4Ever0/vimgolf_challenges_and_solutions@5263d1e9). Original harness: vimgolf-benchmark.py --runner single_shot (one LLM call, last line = solution), scored by vimgolf-evaluate.py --validator vimgolf-validator --solution-not-longer-than-output (replay in agile4im/vimgolf-verifier:v0.0.3, sha256 match, keystrokes <= len(output)).

harbor_adapter.notes: Oracle-covered subset: 470 of 612 challenges, those with a replay-verified oracle within the keystroke budget (oracle/excluded.txt lists the rest; --include-unverified emits all 612). Pass rates are not comparable with full-612 results (median output length 244.5 included vs 87.5 excluded). All 470 oracles reach reward 1 under harbor run -a oracle (Docker, Harbor 0.24.0). Separate no-network verifier holding only the sha256 of the expected output; replay runs as nobody with the agent-shipped files (/app/solution.txt, /logs/artifacts) unreadable. Agent phase network: LLM API allowlist. Parity pending.
